title: mspp_websitelanguage
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): mspp_createdby, mspp_modifiedby, mspp_PublishingState, mspp_WebsiteId.

mspp_createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

mspp_displayname.description: Localized display name of the portal language

mspp_languagecode.description: Locale or language identifier that appears in the URL to indicate the portal language

mspp_lcid.description: Locale ID that is assigned to the portal language

mspp_modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was modified.

mspp_systemlanguage.description: The system language determines which portal languages are available

mspp_websitelcid.description: This attribute is used only in Power Pages Management App, and only for UI purpose.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Website Language

_mspp_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_mspp_publishingstate_value.description: Lookup to Publishing State - publishing state of this website/language instance (draft/published)
